# v0.7.0b2 — Guided LAN setup and clearer connection health

Beta of the integration and app. **0.6.1 remains stable.**

Changes compared with stable 0.6.1:

- **Optional Waveshare setup:** recognize compatible single-channel adapters,
  configure their communication settings and enable or disable TCP login from
  the integration or app. Changes are checked and rolled back on failure.
- **Connection health:** sustained heartbeat and service failures create Repairs
  notices that clear after recovery. Confirmed password rejection requests new
  credentials; temporary connection problems continue to retry.
- **Clearer settings:** separate feature menus show only selected options.
  Optional vehicle adapters remain independent of manual dates, calendars and
  ordinary HA sensors.
- **Reliability fixes:** improved tariff dialogs and annual refresh, charging
  targets, departure planning, queued-command expiry and loss estimates. Planned
  charging commands are cancelled when unplugging is confirmed, and uncertain
  adapter changes keep the old connection stopped.
- **App installation:** the release image includes the complete connection page;
  both processor architectures use the same build and AppArmor checks.

Keep your existing HA entry and app data. For the new adapter features in service
mode, update the app to **0.7.0b2** through **#apps-beta**, then the integration.
Ordinary service connections still support API 2 and service 0.6.1 or newer;
direct USB/LAN needs no app. **#apps** stays on stable 0.6.1.

TCP login uses the adapter's existing web password. It does not encrypt Modbus
traffic; firmware 1.523 has a documented authentication weakness. Keep the adapter
on a trusted network. See [supported adapters and limits](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.7.0b2/docs/lan-adapters.md).

[Update guide](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.7.0b2/docs/upgrading.md)
